title: Application or agent profile
description: One profile (handbook, Part C; DC-45): what a consumer of the brain sees, in which views and pages, which governed edits it may make, which context packs it gets, and its rights. Build from the consumer (DEC-0037): a part of the ontology is configured because a profile reads it.

audience.description: Who uses the profile, in plain words.

role.description: The role the profile serves, when one exists in seed.yaml.

spines.description: Spine keys from spines.yaml the profile sees.

types.description: Node types the profile sees; * = every type.

relations.description: Relations the profile follows; * = every relation.

read.description: Node types the profile may read; * = every type in its lens.

write.description: none: reads only; propose: every output is a proposal a person accepts; actions: only through the profile's actions.

where.description: Keeps only the items at the end of the path whose fact matches (as in page definitions).

columns.description: An outline: the facts of the items at the end of the path; a column empty in every row is left out.

sub.description: An outline: facts shown as labelled lines under an item's name.

process.description: An outline: each item also shows its steps of this process and what it misses to leave its step.

order_by.description: The fact the rows are sorted by, as text; rows without it come last.

root_types.description: The types the view starts from.

paths.description: Relation paths from the root types, in display order.

process.description: A board's columns: the steps of this process.

group_by.description: A type the rows are grouped under (e.g. Component).

color_by.description: What colours the items: a fact, docs_completeness, check_status, rule results.

rules.description: Rule ids the view shows results of.

layout.description: A list view that draws everything below on one page: the root rows with their columns, and under each row its paths as tables.

where.description: An outline: keeps only the root rows whose fact matches.

section_by.description: An outline: a fact of the roots; its value heads the rows that share it, in their order.

emphasis.description: An outline: marks the rows whose fact matches.

title_fact.description: An outline: the fact a root row is titled by, else the node's name.

lead.description: An outline: the fact that says in one sentence what a root row is.

sub.description: An outline: facts shown as labelled lines under a root row's title.

collapsed.description: An outline: what is below a root row is folded until it is opened.

notes.description: An outline: sentences shown on top while some node of the type matches; {count} is how many do.

labels.description: An outline: display texts per fact and value.

also.description: An outline: nodes of a type below the root rows, tied to none of them.

position.description: Above or below the root rows; below when not given.

change.description: The field (`<Type>.<fact>`, name, description) or relation (`<From> <relation> <To>`) the action changes; an entry of edit-sources.yaml.

to_value.description: The value the action sets, when it sets one (e.g. approved).

criteria.description: Rule ids that must pass before the action is offered (DC-42).

writeback.description: How the change reaches its source (DC-43): a pull request on the source file (DEC-0034, source-owned).

autonomy.description: A person commits every change; nothing is applied automatically (DC-76 later).

include.description: Relation paths from the root, each with what it adds to the pack.

with_source_paths.description: Each item carries the file path where it is defined.
